appliedUpdates.description: Documented MockOta OTA session state machine: not_started → in_progress → finalized/rolled_back. begin() sets in_progress=true, successful finalize() sets in_progress=false, rollback_and_reboot() sets in_progress=false. Failed operations leave state unchanged.
Documented MAX_FIRMWARE_SIZE constant (1_835_008 bytes = 1.75 MiB) in launa-ota, placed outside cfg gates so it's available for real OTA code too.
